title: 3d Portfolio Website
description: For this project, I wanted to create a portfolio website to show off the projects that I have done throughout my university and career. I wanted to implement 3d objects into the website as it would be interesting to learn about how to create 3d objects using Blender and use them to build a website. I created my own 3d room using Blender, in which I learnt how to create and render 3d objects to be displayed using three.js, which is a package that deals with creating 3d websites. I have currently implemented the main parts of the website but I am constantly updating the website with implementing new features and talking about more projects that I have done.
technologies: Blender, React Typescript, Github Pages, Three.js
learnings: How to create and render 3d objects in Blender, How to use three.js to implement 3d objects in a website, How to implement animations for a website using three.js, How to use Github Pages to display a GitHub repo as a website
